about_the_game: "Exorcise Evil II" is a game themed around Chinese-style Taoist priests, adapted from a large number of folk tales. In the story, the warlord melee has caused the country to be torn apart and the people to suffer greatly. Amidst this continuous turmoil, an undercurrent that has been brewing for a millennium is quietly surging. Players will assume the role of Taoist disciples, traversing mountains and rivers, exorcising demons and capturing ghosts, and seeking the truth. There are unclear rights and wrongs, and unbreakable loves and hatreds. After all the sails have passed, will they still be able to stay true to their original hearts? Searching for treasures, exorcising evil spirits, holding rituals, drawing talismans and refining corpses... An unprecedented battle between humans and ghosts, and endless entanglement with the supernatural and evil.
